snippet.title: Infinity Nikki - Version 1.5 [Bubble Season] Preview | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/infinity-nikki/

Infinity Nikki Version 1.5 [Bubble Season] will be available after the update on April 28 (UTC-7)! 
Two limited resonance outfits will be introduced, featuring 5 free outfits including the Sea of Stars evoking cherished memories from previous Nikki games.

#ps5 #ps5games #infinitynikki
